name: Ideal Age Gate
author: idealpc

sections.description:
Ideal Age Gate asks visitors to confirm their age before they enter the site. It is free and also exists for Joomla.

  • Yes/no buttons or date of birth (the age is calculated in the browser, nothing is sent)
  • Ready-made texts for alcohol, tobacco and e-cigarettes, CBD, adult content and gambling, translated through translate.wordpress.org (follows the language of the page, also with WPML or Polylang)
  • Minimum age of your choice, shown in the texts and on the « 18+ » icon
  • Refusal: message with « Back » and « Leave the site », or redirection to a page or URL
  • Styles: light, dark, YOOtheme Pro (cards and buttons of your theme) or your own colours; image, logo and icon
  • Remembered until midnight, for a number of hours or days, or for the session
  • On all pages, all pages except your legal pages, or only on some pages
  • Works with page caching (the decision is made in the browser), accessible (keyboard, screen readers)
  • With the YOOtheme Pro theme: an « Ideal Age Gate » element for the page builder
sections.installation:
1. Plugins › Add New › Upload Plugin, choose the ZIP and activate.
  2. Settings › Ideal Age Gate: switch on « Show the age gate » in the Display tab and choose the pages.
sections.faq:
Does it check the visitor’s identity?

No. It is a declaration of age: visitors confirm their age or enter their date of birth. For online sales, add the age check required by law at checkout or delivery.

Which cookie does it set?

Only « idealagegate=1 » in the visitor’s browser, after confirmation (technically necessary cookie, no personal data). The date of birth is never sent to the server.

Does it work with page caching?

Yes. The page is always the same; the decision to show the window is made in the browser.

How do I keep my legal pages readable?

Settings › Ideal Age Gate › Display: choose « On all pages except those selected » and tick your legal notice and privacy policy pages.

Do I need YOOtheme Pro?

No. The window set in Settings › Ideal Age Gate works with any theme. With YOOtheme Pro you also get an « Ideal Age Gate » element in the page builder.
